raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With the aiter attention backend, an fp8 KV cache and calibrated KV scales (for example from the checkpoint), speculative decoding produces garbage when target verify takes the legacy path, which every non-MLA target verify (NGRAM, EAGLE) takes unless unified verify applies (topk 1 with unified attention on, i.e. an SWA pool or `SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1`); this is from reading the code, and only NGRAM is measured below. On that path `AiterAttnBackend.forward_extend` calls `extend_attention_fwd` with `k_scale` and `v_scale` hard-coded to 1.0, added in #19736 to fix a missing-argument TypeError. The cache holds `K / k_scale`, so the cached prefix is read back unscaled. #46528 fixed the decode and NHD prefill reads but not this call; the triton backend passes `layer.k_scale_float` at the same place.

## Modifications

- `aiter_backend.py`: pass `layer.k_scale_float` / `layer.v_scale_float` when the cache is fp8 and the layer has scales, otherwise 1.0. The Triton kernel always multiplies the cached prefix by the scale, so a bf16 cache must keep 1.0; this is the same check `forward_extend` already makes for its other paths.
- `test_aiter_fp8_kv_scales_paths.py`: add `test_extend_attention_target_verify`, three requests with 300, 77 and 512 cached fp8 prefix tokens and 4 draft tokens each, against fp32 attention over the dequantized cache. To support it, `_FakeKVPool` gets `get_key_buffer` / `get_value_buffer`, `_make_layer` sets `k_scale_float` / `v_scale_float`, and the causal reference mask is offset so the queries are the last positions of the sequence. On main the new case fails with a relative L2 error of 322.19 (threshold 0.15); with this PR it is 0.04.

## Accuracy Tests

MI355X (gfx950), torch 2.11.0+rocm10.0.0, sglang-kernel 0.4.10, aiter `285579b62`, `SGLANG_USE_AITER=1`, CUDA graphs on. Model `amd/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8-KV` (per-layer checkpoint KV scales from 0.024 to 0.075) with `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`; NGRAM uses its defaults. Main is `7fe5b127e4`. Only the main run used `--max-total-tokens 2000000`; the PR and no-speculation runs used the default KV pool. GSM8K with `python -m sglang.test.run_eval --eval-name gsm8k --num-examples 1319 --max-tokens 4096` (chat API, greedy, 1314 questions after the 5 few-shot examples):

| Config | Main | This PR |
|---|---|---|
| aiter + NGRAM | 0.0061 | 0.8037 / 0.8067 / 0.8052 |
| aiter, no speculation | | 0.8135 / 0.8067 / 0.8181 |
| triton + NGRAM (reference) | | 0.7968 |

On main the aiter + NGRAM outputs are garbage that run to the 4096-token limit (5.4M output tokens), and with the default KV pool those long outputs hit a separate int32 offset overflow in `extend_attention_fwd` (#47029), hence the smaller pool for that run.

Unit tests: `test_aiter_fp8_kv_scales_paths.py` passes on MI355X and MI325X.

MI325X (gfx942), torch 2.11.0+rocm10.0.0, aiter `285579b62`, main `cb55d77d37` with this patch: the new case fails on main and passes here. GSM8K aiter + NGRAM with `--max-total-tokens 2000000` on both arms: main 0.0050 (200 questions), this PR 0.7998 / 0.8174; aiter without speculation 0.8288.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

MI355X, same stack as above. The kernel and launch are unchanged; only the `k_scale` / `v_scale` values passed to `extend_attention_fwd` differ. Kernel time on the legacy target-verify path (Llama-3.1-8B shapes, fp8 KV, 12 draft tokens, causal), 20 calls in one CUDA graph, median of 50 replays, µs per call:

| Batch | Prefix | Scale 1.0 (main) | Layer scales (this PR) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1024 | 35.0 | 35.1 |
| 1 | 8192 | 292.2 | 292.2 |
| 8 | 1024 | 38.0 | 38.0 |
| 8 | 8192 | 289.8 | 289.9 |
| 32 | 1024 | 160.7 | 160.7 |
| 32 | 8192 | 1387.8 | 1387.7 |

End to end, aiter + NGRAM with `--max-total-tokens 2000000` on both arms, `python -m sglang.bench_serving --backend sglang --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 512 --random-range-ratio 1.0` (fixed output length). Blocks main, PR, PR, main with one server each; each block reports the median of runs 2-4:

| Concurrency | Output throughput, main → PR (tok/s) | Median TPOT, main → PR (ms) | Accept length, main → PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 177 → 1066 (PR blocks 991 / 1141) | 5.66 → 0.66 | 1.04 → 3.70 |
| 32 | 1770 → 7010 (PR blocks 7120 / 6900) | 17.90 → 2.97 | 1.04 → 4.14 |

The end-to-end gain comes from NGRAM accepting drafts again; on main the garbage outputs reject almost every draft. The two main blocks differ by 0.1% (c1) and 0.8% (c32) in throughput.

## Reproduce

```bash
SGLANG_USE_AITER=1 python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path amd/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8-KV \
  --attention-backend aiter --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 --speculative-algorithm NGRAM
# Main arm: add --max-total-tokens 2000000.

python -m sglang.test.run_eval --eval-name gsm8k --num-examples 1319 --max-tokens 4096
```

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

files.patch:
@@ -4252,6 +4252,11 @@ def forward_extend(
 
                 self._reject_target_verify_cross_layer_kv(k, v)
 
+                # extend_attention_fwd takes the KV scales as host floats.
+                k_scale = v_scale = 1.0
+                if self.kv_cache_dtype == fp8_dtype and layer.k_scale is not None:
+                    k_scale, v_scale = layer.k_scale_float, layer.v_scale_float
+
                 self.extend_attention_fwd(
                     q.view(-1, layer.tp_q_head_num, layer.qk_head_dim),
                     k.contiguous(),
@@ -4266,8 +4271,8 @@ def forward_extend(
                     True,  # causal
                     self.forward_metadata.mask_indptr,
                     self.forward_metadata.max_extend_len,
-                    1.0,  # k_scale
-                    1.0,  # v_scale
+                    k_scale,
+                    v_scale,
                     layer.scaling,
                     logit_cap=layer.logit_cap,
                 )

@@ -2,7 +2,7 @@
 that apply the layer's softmax scale.
 
 Each case stores ``K / k_scale`` and ``V / v_scale`` in an fp8 cache, runs one
-``AiterAttnBackend`` path with the real aiter kernel, and compares the output with
+``AiterAttnBackend`` path with its real kernel, and compares the output with
 fp32 attention over the dequantized cache. With unit scales, mixing up q's scale
 with ``k_scale`` or skipping the cache dequantization does not change the result, so
 the scales are kept far from 1. For the same reason the softmax scale also runs at
@@ -28,6 +28,7 @@
 
 _RUNNABLE = is_hip()
 if _RUNNABLE:
+    from sglang.kernels.ops.attention.extend_attention import extend_attention_fwd
     from sglang.kernels.ops.kvcache.shuffle_5d_cache import (
         launch_reshape_and_cache_shuffle_5d,
     )
@@ -62,6 +63,12 @@ def __init__(self, k_cache, v_cache):
     def get_kv_buffer(self, _layer_id):
         return self.k_cache, self.v_cache
 
+    def get_key_buffer(self, _layer_id):
+        return self.k_cache
+
+    def get_value_buffer(self, _layer_id):
+        return self.v_cache
+
 
 def _offsets(lens):
     return [0, *itertools.accumulate(lens)]
@@ -125,6 +132,7 @@ def _make_backend(self, k_cache, v_cache):
         backend.k_scale = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device=_DEVICE)
         backend.v_scale = torch.ones(1, dtype=torch.float32, device=_DEVICE)
         backend.token_to_kv_pool = _FakeKVPool(k_cache, v_cache)
+        backend.extend_attention_fwd = extend_attention_fwd
         return backend
 
     def _make_layer(self, k_scale, v_scale, scaling=_HEAD_DIM**-0.5):
@@ -138,6 +146,8 @@ def _make_layer(self, k_scale, v_scale, scaling=_HEAD_DIM**-0.5):
             head_dim=_HEAD_DIM,
             k_scale=k_scale,
             v_scale=v_scale,
+            k_scale_float=k_scale.item() if k_scale is not None else None,
+            v_scale_float=v_scale.item() if v_scale is not None else None,
             sliding_window_size=-1,
             scaling=scaling,
             logit_cap=0.0,
@@ -351,6 +361,72 @@ def _check_vectorized_5d_prefill(self, prefix_lens, extend_lens):
         )
         self._assert_close(out, expected)
 
+    def test_extend_attention_target_verify(self):
+        prefix_lens = [300, 77, 512]
+        num_draft = 4
+        batch = len(prefix_lens)
+        offsets = _offsets(p + num_draft for p in prefix_lens)
+        q, ((k_fp8, k_deq, k_scale), (v_fp8, v_deq, v_scale)) = self._make_inputs(
+            batch * num_draft, offsets[-1]
+        )
+        # Target verify reads the committed prefix from the cache and the draft
+        # tokens from k / v.
+        prefix_loc = torch.cat(
+            [
+                torch.arange(s, s + p, dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEVICE)
+                for s, p in zip(offsets, prefix_lens)
+            ]
+        )
+        draft_loc = torch.cat(
+            [torch.arange(e - num_draft, e, device=_DEVICE) for e in offsets[1:]]
+        )
+
+        backend = self._make_backend(k_fp8, v_fp8)
+        backend.forward_metadata = SimpleNamespace(
+            qo_indptr=torch.arange(
+                0,
+                (batch + 1) * num_draft,
+                num_draft,
+                dtype=torch.int32,
+                device=_DEVICE,
+            ),
+            kv_indptr=torch.tensor(
+                _offsets(prefix_lens), dtype=torch.int32, device=_DEVICE
+            ),
+            kv_indices=prefix_loc,
+            custom_mask=None,
+            mask_indptr=None,
+            max_extend_len=num_draft,
+        )
+        forward_batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.TARGET_VERIFY,
+            attn_attend_prefix_cache=False,
+            out_cache_loc=None,
+        )
+
+        out = backend.forward_extend(
+            q,
+            k_deq[draft_loc].bfloat16(),
+            v_deq[draft_loc].bfloat16(),
+            self._make_layer(k_scale, v_scale),
+            forward_batch,
+            save_kv_cache=False,
+        )
+
+        expected = torch.cat(
+            [
+                _reference_attention(
+                    q[b * num_draft : (b + 1) * num_draft],
+                    k_deq[s:e],
+                    v_deq[s:e],
+                    True,
+                    _HEAD_DIM**-0.5,
+                )
+                for b, (s, e) in enumerate(zip(offsets, offsets[1:]))
+            ]
+        )
+        self._assert_close(out, expected)
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
